end.summary:
- Discussed how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
- Discussed how soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil.
- Pihu repeatedly said earthworms spoil soil, eat crops, or harm plant roots.
- This mix-up was not corrected by the end of the lesson; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil, and how soil animals help make rich soil from dead leaves. Pihu shared observations from seeing an earthworm in the garden and in a grandmother’s pot. Pihu continued to mix up earthworms with harmful pests, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, look at a simple picture of an earthworm tunnel and say together: “The tunnel lets air and water in; earthworms help the soil.”
